newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rupiah strengthens in dull late trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rupiah strengthens in dull late trading.

text.p: Indonesia's rupiah strengthened against the dollar in dull late trading on Tuesday as operators stayed on the sidelines ahead of Christmas, dealers said.
"Some operators had already gone home for Christmas before the market closed. Trading volume is thin as there's not much activity in the market," one Japanese bank dealer said.
The dealer said the thin trading volume and a lack of active operators made it easier for the remaining players to have an impact on the market.
Another dealer said the rupiah managed to edge higher in late trading despite ample liquidity due to the thin volume.
Spot rupiah was last quoted at 2,361.75/62.50 against an opening of 2,363.25/64.00.
The dealer said the spot rupiah rate was likely to range between 2,363.00 and 2,364.00 on Thursday.
Overnight swap was last traded at -0.05/par against an opening of par/0.15. Tom/next was last at 0.15/0.25 points against an opening of 0.20/0.40. Today rupiah were last quoted at 2,363.85/63.35.
One-month swap was last at 13.25/13.75, two at 29.00/30.00. three at 41.25/42.00 and six at 85.25/86.00.
Bank Indonesia raised its intervention band by one point to 2,357/2,549 and the conversion band also by one point to 2,357/2,405 late on Tuesday.
The market will be closed on Wednesday for Christmas.
